column1: # A rule that is not listed defaults to WARN, so a new alert always shows up rather than passing
# silently. IGNORE means the team has looked at the alert and accepted it; the reasoning lives in
# doc/zap-triage.md, which must be updated in the same PR as any change here.
# Note the build does NOT pass or fail on these levels. The workflow fails on any High-severity
# alert and reports the rest (see .github/workflows/zap.yml), so IGNORE only controls the noise in
# Accepted: caching alerts on the static SPA shell and its bundle, which are public files with
# nothing private in them. The API side of the same alerts was fixed instead, not ignored: it now
# sends Cache-Control: no-store on every response (middleware/security.js).

column3: Re-examine Cache-control Directives — public SPA shell only
Storable but Non-Cacheable Content — static assets, nothing private
Retrieved from Cache — consequence of serving a static SPA from a CDN
